{{Quote|What, impossible. You were restrained by a neural disruptor!|Brejik|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Neural disruptors''' were devices similar to collars attached to [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]' necks to incapacitate them. [[Brejik]] used this device on [[Bastila Shan]], only to be outwitted by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who managed to resist it and take it off with help from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

[[Force field/Legends|Force fields]] could also be equipped with neural disruptors. As soon as the field is touched, a vicious electrical charge burns through the victim's [[nervous system]], paralyzing them with agonizing pain.<ref name="Isis">''[[The Isis Coordinates]]''</ref> Cells aboard the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] taking prisoners from the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|Desolator]]'' to the secret [[Miser Naval Base|Imperial Naval Base]] on [[Miser/Legends|Miser]] were equipped with neural disruptor fields.<ref name="Isis" />
